# Citation_Scope_Constraint

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A rule that citations may only support propositions actually present in the cited source, and biological analogies cannot substitute for engineering validation. Maintains rigor in TCC/iNEST by ensuring evidence-based reasoning and preventing metaphorical overreach in technical claims.
